# W-something: the landing is a shown proposal, not a phrase (card P08b)

Free-form chat must decide the landing change from a plain showing the owner confirms, the way the
flaky release approval was rebuilt. No keyword gate on the owner's words, and no message that tells
the owner what to say.

- [ ] PLAN.md written (this file).
- [ ] `chat/commands.ts`: export `LANDING_MEANS` (one plain sentence per name in `LANDINGS`, `main-automatic` says "main by itself" and "no human step"); `describe()` puts ` (from now on, <sentence>)` before the fields for `integration.set`, `integration.default.set` and `project.create`; every value, key and label that reaches the line is escaped (no raw line break, U+2028/U+2029, bidi override) and every cut lands between whole characters and whole escapes; delete `saysMainAutomatic`.
- [ ] `chat/chat.ts`: the landing commands are always a proposal for any owner words (no phrase gate, no refusal that teaches a phrase); the proposal names the checks that gate the landing, read now, in the preview; the shown checks are pinned into what confirming sends, and a project whose checks moved in between is refused at confirmation.
- [ ] `chat/chat.ts` + `shorthand.ts` + `commands/commands.ts` + `health/escalation-ladder.ts`: refusals that taught a wording pattern say "in your own words" instead.
- [ ] `chat/landing-words.test.ts` deleted; `release-words.test.ts` no longer imports the words check; new `chat/landing-proposal.test.ts` with ordinary sentences (proposal for any wording, never applied without confirming, discard, checks named in the preview, drift refused, lock refused, no wording to copy); `api/start-integration.test.ts` and `chat/meeting-decision-chat-suite.ts` updated to the new behaviour and texts.
- [ ] Docs: `npm run api:docs:write`, and an entry in `docs/nimblenewt/implementation-plan/implementation-notes.md` marking the old phrase-gate entries superseded.
- [ ] Build and run the chat, api, policy, status and release test files in the sandbox; all pass.
